ledger_correction.explanation: Constant-only extraction missed interpolated CLI fixture strings. Python 3.14 tokenize emits FSTRING_START/MIDDLE/END. The enrichment reconstructs these without executing code, substitutes __HOST_EXPRESSION__ and retains actual host_template_source and host_interpolations (usually out). Physical host lines, including adjacent literals spanning a generated line, are preserved.
ledger_correction.namespace_policy: Every declaration and non-underscore imported module attribute is enumerated. Imported typing/build123d/PIL/OCP aliases are classified as incidental module-visible bindings, not 199 new wonky kernel APIs. Public-looking resolve_out in the private _paths module is retained, not silently omitted.

stored_outputs.interpretation: Stored output snapshots are real reference artifacts, not proof of current source freshness, current kernel support or print safety. No artifact regenerated here. Mechanism ok means declared assertions passed, not that every pair is collision-free; overhang null under a 91-degree waiver is not a general support-free certificate.

package_policy_addendum.status: Recommendations, not implemented policy. Current runner refuses all unprovided packages; citation <repo>/docs/python-khana.md:171-219. Full package investigation is concurrently owned by corpus-package-policy/main.

packages.use: Array arithmetic, bounds comparison, axis-vector costs, mesh buffers and summary percentiles.
packages.policy: Allow pinned pure-numeric/data use outside the Bend geometry authority; never let host arrays become a hidden external shape/query implementation.

packages.use: Test assertions, approx and expected failure contexts; test modules are not model entrypoints.
packages.policy: Allow as test tooling in a test runner; do not implement a pytest clone in the kernel or treat a test module's missing result as missing geometry capability.

packages.use: Mesh reconstruction/caching, plane slicing, subdivision and spatial mesh analysis.
packages.policy: Integrate production mesh, section and diagnostic capabilities natively with explicit approximate lineage; refuse external geometric authority. Optional independent exported-artifact analysis must remain outside production modeling.

packages.use: Actually modeled printable ISO and trapezoidal threads, not merely bought fasteners.
packages.policy: Native parameter catalogs and exact/thread-aware Bend construction; refuse OCCT-backed construction until supported. Do not substitute smooth shafts and call them complete threads.

packages.use: Surface geometry adaptors and BREP read/write caches, plus external-kernel queries.
packages.policy: Keep refusing in production. Port capabilities to Bend; OCCT allowed only as independent validation of exported artifacts, never construction or fallback geometry.

packages.use: Design-language and manufacturing-profile data loading with safe_load.
packages.policy: Allow pinned data-only YAML tooling or native config ingestion; this is not an external geometry dependency. Include profiles in provenance and dependency watching.

packages.use: Headless review diagrams/contact sheets using Agg and pyplot.
packages.policy: Allow host-side report rendering; not a geometry authority or required kernel dependency.

packages.use: Mixed: convex hull defines a board geometry envelope; linear_sum_assignment performs numerical matching.
packages.policy: Split by capability: allow non-geometric optimization/matching, implement production hull/spatial geometry natively. A blanket SciPy allow would admit external geometry.

packages.use: 2D union/intersection and buffered point circles create physical plate profiles.
packages.policy: Integrate sketch-region Boolean/offset/hull capabilities in Bend; keep refusing GEOS-backed geometry. Point.buffer(resolution=96) is polygonal intent and must not silently masquerade as an analytic circle.

packages.use: HTTP client for a project geometry-service bridge.
packages.policy: Allow only explicit host-side transport with provenance/permissions; not unrestricted in deterministic modeling and never a remote geometry fallback.

packages.use: OCP viewer topology-index ordering for pick tests.
packages.policy: Native tessellation and stable topology-to-view ID mapping; no OCP topology dependency in production. Preserve or explicitly map compatibility indices.

packages.use: Raster image/drawing output for review artifacts.
packages.policy: Allow optional host-side image tooling, or replace with existing native viewer exports; no need to absorb all Pillow into Bend.

native_primitive_requirements: Bend Boolean intersection/common-volume with bounded analytic mass properties and overlap centroid; distinguish contact, positive overlap, unresolved and invalid topology.
Trim-aware body-to-body minimum distance with witness points/features, certified intervals and equality/near-threshold handling; AABB or tessellation-only distance is not enough for clearance gates.
Analytic trimmed-face nearest positive ray hits plus material membership to avoid same-face wall self-hits; existing supporting-surface roots alone do not establish solid crossings.
Face topology/adjacency, surface type/radius, oriented normals, dihedral/convexity classification and stable IDs across viewer/report; preserve analytic curves.
Certified display/print tessellation with face lineage and declared deflection for approximate area/support sampling, never presented as exact wall-global-minimum proof.
Connected component/shell containment, bore/pin classification, bridge-anchor material probes and print-axis support/contact analysis with explicit approximation labels.
Hierarchical rigid transforms and stable instance identity for static/motion report caching and GLB animation; sample-based clearance does not prove continuous motion.
Native exact analytic STEP and bounded STL/GLB export; planar region operations, offsets, threads and standard-part construction must be Bend-owned rather than bd_warehouse/GEOS/OCCT fallback.
